label: Generic warm-water pond aquaculture — demonstration settings
applies_to: Warm-water freshwater finfish ponds (e.g. Indian major carps, tilapia, pangasius). Not tuned for shrimp, brackish water, hatcheries or any specific species.
notes: Bands are informed by commonly cited general ranges in warm-water pond aquaculture literature (e.g. Boyd, C.E., Water Quality in Ponds for Aquaculture, 1990). The exact numbers in this file have NOT been checked against a specific published table for any species or for coastal Karnataka conditions. A qualified fisheries professional must review them before any real use.
source_label: Demonstration setting — informed by general warm-water aquaculture guidance; not validated

unionized_ammonia_mg_l.label: Un-ionised ammonia (derived from TAN, pH and temperature)

total_ammonia_mg_l.label: Total ammonia nitrogen (fallback when pH or temperature is missing)

gasping_at_surface.explanation: Fish gulping at the surface is a common sign of low dissolved oxygen.

abnormal_mortality.explanation: Unusual deaths need prompt inspection by a fisheries professional.

erratic_swimming.explanation: Erratic swimming can accompany water-quality stress or disease.

reduced_feeding.explanation: Reduced feeding is an early, non-specific stress sign.

lethargy.explanation: Sluggish fish are a non-specific stress sign.

red_patches_or_lesions.explanation: Red patches or ulcers may be associated with infection; diagnosis needs a professional.

white_spots.explanation: White spots may be associated with parasites; diagnosis needs a professional.

fin_or_tail_rot.explanation: Eroded fins or tails may be associated with infection; diagnosis needs a professional.

cotton_like_growth.explanation: Cotton-like growth may be associated with fungal infection; diagnosis needs a professional.

bloated_abdomen.explanation: Abdominal swelling has several possible causes; diagnosis needs a professional.
